title: Kobbledkarp Cobblemon
description: Kobbledkarp is a player economy driven cobblemon server, with lots of content for solo or group play! There are both NPC gyms and player gyms. NPC Elite4/Champion and endgame content. Grindable and collectable items/pokemon to give you lots to do.
body:
Kobbledkarp is a player-economy survival Cobblemon server built for both solo adventurers and groups. There’s always something to chase, whether you’re climbing the ranks, building a team, or hunting down rare collectibles.

You’ll find a full mix of NPC gyms and player-run gyms, plus NPC Elite Four/Champion fights and a solid layer of endgame challenges. The world is packed with grindable goals and collectible Pokémon/items, so progress always feels earned and there’s always a “next thing” to work toward.

Things you can dive into:

Battle Tower & Battle Factory

Breeding & team building

Gyms, hunts, STS, and raids

Custom texture variants

Monthly events

Ranked ladder & tournaments

Build competitions

Player shops + a thriving economy

…and plenty more content on top of that.
